result.summary: Found 1 issue: a loading spinner overlay is stuck on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, obscuring the content.

issues.description: A white circular loading spinner with a green progress arc is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar cover image in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring the food photo.
issues.suggestion: Dismiss the loading indicator once the image has loaded and ensure the cover image renders cleanly without an overlay; only show a placeholder/spinner while the image is actually loading.
